title: Jammy Tender Indian Rice Khichdi
description: A solo dinner Indian dish featuring pecorino romano and dashi extract, this khichdi is jammy, tender, and gluten free friendly. It is a Tamil inspired recipe with a unique blend of flavors.
instructions: Heat ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add mung dal and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add Indian rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add water, salt, turmeric, and dashi extract to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in grated pecorino romano and continue to simmer for 5 minutes, or until the khichdi is jammy and tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
